correctness.rationale: Exact substitution establishes the full-line Gaussian mixture solution and four-dimensional closure. Infection and susceptible fractions stay in the simplex, and susceptibility converges to zero by a growth contradiction. The cubic mixture skewness has sharp maximum \(1/(6\sqrt3)\); its monotonicity after the maximizer establishes the unique subcritical minimum. A rational-parameter witness provides positive, negative and eventually positive variance-derivative signs with an analytic infection upper bound and logistic threshold. Standalone symbolic residual, rational signs, and independent quadrature checks passed; infinite-time statements are proven analytically.

value.rationale: The exact phase boundary separates a region where mutation necessarily broadens infectivity among all two-mode initial distributions from a region in which selective modal replacement can narrow it. The explicit all-positive-parameter double reversal demonstrates a qualitative failure of monotone diffusive broadening and of the near-symmetric variance approximation in the source model. A sharp universal threshold with a concrete dynamical interpretation is a meaningful mathematical classification rather than a routine one-off computation.
